title: Architectural Spec
description: A structural specification for internal refactoring, trait extraction, AST transforms, and subsystem invariants where types and architectural invariants are the primary contract.

purpose.description: Why this structural refactoring is required and the defect class or bottleneck it eliminates.

scope.description: Crates, modules, and data structures touched by this refactor.

target_crates.description: List of crate names or workspace packages involved in this architectural refactor.

non_goals.description: Explicitly excluded structural changes or deferred refactors.

invariant_rule.description: Rigid architectural property that must hold (e.g. CST format preservation, atomic tempfile rename, no clone on hot path).

criterion.description: A testable proposition — something confirmable true or false via compilation, unit tests, or static proof.

target_crate.description: The specific crate or module where this criterion is verified.

linked_findings.description: Finding IDs from proof or audit reports that this structural refactor resolves.

spec_file_path.description: Workspace-relative path where this spec is written on disk (e.g. .claude/specs/ARCH-SPEC-001.json).

revision_note.description: Describes what changed and why if revised after gate rejection.
